install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The project's own compose file pulls a GHCR-hosted image via pkg-containers.githubusercontent.com, which this sandbox's egress policy denies. m1k1o/neko is the same project's image also officially published to Docker Hub - pointed a new compose file at m1k1o/neko:firefox instead, reached via the org's already-allowed Docker Hub route, keeping the same WebRTC port range and shared-memory size the project documents.
